study: Dual Momentum Rank-Depth / Edge-Decay Audit v1

canonicalInputs.informationBoundary: all scores use closes strictly before the rebalance session; outcomes use rebalance open through next rebalance open

primaryHypotheses.H3: forward edge decreases monotonically as numeric rank worsens

inference.null: preserve each rebalance's securities and future returns while permuting score, rank and rank-derived labels within that rebalance

materiality.strongEvidence: H1 observed difference >= 1 percentage point per rebalance period, clustered CI lower bound > 0, first-half and second-half differences > 0, every leave-one-year-out and leave-one-security-out difference > 0, and H1 remains > 0 after removing its top 1 percent outcomes
materiality.weakEvidence: H1 observed difference > 0 but one or more strong-evidence conditions fail
materiality.top5BoundaryUnsupported: H2 observed difference <= 0 or its clustered confidence interval includes zero
materiality.nonMonotonic: rank-level means do not decrease monotonically and H3 rank/return Spearman is not negative with a clustered confidence interval below zero

prohibited: building alternative top-N portfolio equity curves
modifying frozen forward tests or Alpaca automation
followUpRule: recommend exactly one separately preregistered top-N portfolio comparison only when the strong-evidence definition is met
